steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction:
Collect all items listed below:
- 2 mL cryogenic vials (Corning, cat. 430488)
- 2 mL homogenization tubes (Labcon Co., cat. 3661‑875‑000)
- Zirconia beads, 1.0 mm (BioSpec Products, cat. 11079110ZX)
- 0.9 % NaCl solution (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. S8776)
- Liquid nitrogen cylinder
- Acetonitrile Optima®, LC‑MS grade (Fisher, cat. A955‑4)
- Deionized (MilliQ) water (Arium Pro, Sartorius)
- Formic acid, HPLC grade (Merck Supelco, cat. 5.43804)
- Dry ice
- Homogenization buffer (see recipe below)
- 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes (Corning Axygen, cat. MCT‑200‑C)
- Waters XBridge Amide column 4.6 × 150 mm, 3.5 µm (cat. 186004869)
- Dichloromethane (CH₂Cl₂) (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 270997)
- Methanol Optima® (Fisher, cat. A456‑4)
- Ammonium acetate (>98 %) (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. A7330‑100g)
- Ammonium hydroxide solution (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 338818)
- Internal Standards kit for Lipidyzer™ (SCIEX, cat. 5040156)
- Nitrogen gas cylinder
- LC solvent A and B (see recipes below)

steps.title: Prepare homogenization buffer
steps.instruction:
Mix the following to obtain 1 L of buffer:
- 498.5 mL acetonitrile (LC‑MS grade)
- 498.5 mL deionized water
- 3 mL formic acid (to give 0.3 % v/v final concentration)

steps.title: Prepare liver homogenate
steps.instruction: Process mouse liver tissue on wet ice as follows:

substeps.instruction: Pre‑chill 0.9 % NaCl solution on wet ice.
Euthanize mouse according to approved protocol and excise liver within 10 min.
Rinse liver in cold 0.9 % NaCl to remove surface blood.
Cut liver into small pieces, place into 2 mL cryogenic vials and snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen; store at –80 °C until use.
Weigh 50–60 mg of frozen liver into a 2 mL homogenization tube; keep on wet ice.
Add ice‑cold homogenization buffer to achieve 50 mg mL⁻¹ (≈1 mL buffer for 50 mg tissue, assuming 50 µL water content).
Add zirconia beads (1.0 mm) to roughly 25 % of the tube’s buffer height.
Homogenize in a Precellys Evolution with Cryolys cooling: 6 cycles × 20 s at 6,500 rpm, 4 °C, with 10 s pauses between cycles.
Aliquot 50 µL of the homogenate, snap‑freeze on dry ice, and store at –80 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Prepare internal standard mix
steps.instruction: Combine the internal standards according to the table (final mix volume 110 µL):

substeps.instruction: CER(16:0‑d9): 0.02 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 36.57 µM
CE(22:6‑d7): 0.15 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 213.18 µM
TAG(52:1/FA18:0‑d9): 0.14 mg mL⁻¹ × 109 µL → final 160.95 µM
DCER(16:0‑d9): 0.004 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 7.29 µM
FFA(17:1): 0.05 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 186.23 µM
HCER(16:0‑d9): 0.03 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 42.31 µM
LCER(16:0‑d9): 0.03 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 34.43 µM
LPC(16:0‑d9): 0.10 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 198.14 µM
LPE(18:0‑d5): 0.05 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 102.75 µM
SM(16:0‑d7): 0.10 mg mL⁻¹ × 110 µL → final 140.92 µM

steps.title: Prepare LC mobile phases
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions (adjust pH of solvent B to match solvent A with ammonium hydroxide):

substeps.instruction: Solvent A (pH 8.2): 1 mM ammonium acetate in 95 % acetonitrile (950 mL ACN + 50 mL water + 1 mM NH₄OAc).
Solvent B (pH 8.2): 1 mM ammonium acetate in 50 % acetonitrile (500 mL ACN + 500 mL water + 1 mM NH₄OAc); add ammonium hydroxide to reach pH 8.2.

steps.title: Prepare quality control samples
steps.instruction: Set up the following controls before extraction:

substeps.instruction: Blank without internal standards: 75 µL methanol only.
Blank with internal standards: 75 µL methanol + 25 µL internal‑standard mix.
Pooled QC: combine equal volumes from at least 10 % of study samples into one tube; run repeatedly throughout the batch.

steps.title: Extract lipids from homogenate
steps.instruction: Perform the biphasic extraction in 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes:

substeps.instruction: Thaw homogenate tubes on ice.
Pipette 25 µL of homogenate into a fresh 2 mL tube.
Add 283 µL deionized H₂O; let stand on ice 10 min.
Add 581 µL methanol (MeOH).
Add 262 µL dichloromethane (CH₂Cl₂).
Cap and vortex vigorously for 5 s (max speed).
Check for a single phase; if two phases appear, add 25 µL MeOH, vortex, repeat until a single phase is observed.
Add 25 µL of the premixed internal‑standard mix, vortex, and incubate 30 min at room temperature.
Add 291 µL deionized H₂O, then 262 µL CH₂Cl₂.
Gently invert the tube 10 times (do NOT vortex) to avoid emulsion.
Pre‑chill a centrifuge to 4 °C; centrifuge at 1,710 × g for 10 min.
Using a micropipette tip ≤200 µL, transfer the lower organic layer to a fresh microcentrifuge tube (Video 2).
Add 581 µL CH₂Cl₂ to the remaining residue, invert 10 times, centrifuge again at 1,710 × g for 10 min, and transfer the lower organic layer to the tube from the previous step.
Evaporate the combined organic extracts to dryness with a nitrogen blower.
Reconstitute the dried lipids in 100 µL methanol.

steps.title: Configure LC gradient
steps.instruction: Set up the HILIC XBridge Amide column (4.6 × 150 mm, 3.5 µm) with the following gradient (flow 0.7 mL min⁻¹, column oven 35 °C):

substeps.instruction: 24 min: stop

steps.title: Configure MS MRM method
steps.instruction: Program the triple‑quadrupole instrument for scheduled MRM as follows:

substeps.instruction: Positive ion mode for SM, CER, DCER, HCER, LCER, TAG, DAG, MAG.
Negative ion mode for PC, PE, PG, PI, PS, FFA.
Set Q1 and Q3 mass windows to the precursor‑product pairs listed in the SCIEX Lipidyzer™ appendix (re‑optimize collision energy for each instrument).
Schedule each transition to the expected retention window based on the LC gradient; verify windows after any column or solvent change.
